families: Favorit SSENSE Inter (grotesque — headlines, UI labels, uppercase)
JHA Times Now (serif, semilight — deks, kickers, dates)
type.case: uppercase for all headlines and UI labels; sentence case for serif prose

notes: Deliberately static site: the 4 @keyframes are loaders (s-loader-blink, s-loader-dash, blink, sk-scaleout); the 9 scroll / 8 mousemove listeners and 83 rAF calls in the probe belong to third-party analytics (TikTok, Pinterest, Datadog, GTM), not to page choreography — the 11-frame scroll sequence corroborates zero page motion. No prefers-reduced-motion rules exist, but the exposure is loaders only. 200ms added to durations from the drawer/overlay transitions in CSS; the probe only saw 350ms/500ms in computed styles. Type scale normalized from px (11 / 13 / 15 / 18 / 20 / 28.5 / 53.2 / 66.5 / 100) and reconstructed from the rem values in the editorial module CSS; it steps at 768/1024/1440 rather than flowing (no clamp()). Tracking converted from the site's per-size px values (-0.05px@20px … -3.75px@100px) into the em-relative constant that actually governs it. No shadows exist: the only boxShadow in the profile is a 1px inset ring used as a border. Page bg white and text #333 confirmed against the screenshots; the probe's theme.dark block is a false positive (supportsDark: false) so no dark axis is recorded. Font family names are provenance only — pair any light grotesque with any semilight serif to reproduce the effect.
